notes.title: Kneedle Knight Triumphs at the Student Game Awards!
notes.notes:
On behalf of the entire [i]Kneedle Knight[/i] team, we are incredibly honored to have won [b]Short Form Game of the Year[/b] and [b]Excellence in Game Mechanics[/b] at the [url=https://linktr.ee/studentgameawards ]Student Game Awards[/url]. 

Additionally, we are proud to have been nominated for [b]Excellence in Score & Music[/b]. The entire team would like to thank the [b]Student Game Awards[/b] as well as all of the fans of the game that have enjoyed playing [i]Kneedle Knight[/i] as much as we did making it. 

Thank you for all of your support!

notes.title: Kneedle Knight Best SMU Guildhall Launch So Far
notes.notes:
The Day 1 Steam downloads number for Kneedle Knight are in and it dethroned last year's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142840/Light_of_Alariya/]Light of Alariya[/url], making Sir Lukos the new king of Day 1 downloads for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/smuguildhall]SMU Guildhall games on Steam[/url]. 

Thanks to everyone who played and helped spread the word. The team is off to a great start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861707/3d931696cd1b868cc5de19bf2f5781bb4740d1fd.png[/img]

notes.title: Kneedle Knight Launches on February 21st
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861707/6270576b0a1b0eecd8ceb73b7cafe6fc5372790b.jpg[/img]
The Kneedle Knight team is so excited you are going to finally be able to play our game next week!  we have been working working incredibly hard to create something special, and we are really proud of the results.  We hope you'll enjoy it, too.

You can help the team out by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist now.  If you play it and enjoy it, please leave a kind review when the time comes.  Every bit of support really helps the team.
